results.title: Rust 2024 - The Rust Edition Guide
results.content: The Rust 2024 edition was stabilized in Rust 1.85. It changes how return-position impl Trait captures lifetimes, [...] makes unsafe extern blocks explicit, and reserves the gen keyword.

results.title: Announcing Rust 1.85.0 and Rust 2024
results.content: Rust 1.85.0 stabilizes the 2024 edition as well as async closures.
